summary: CLAIM C-0002: The labor force was NOT slaves; it was a large, organized, well-fed workforce of Egyptian citizens (consensus).
content: The labor force was not slaves; this is established consensus among Egyptologists. Workers were organized Egyptian citizens, skilled and well-fed, paid in food and lodging (EV-0012, EV-0013, EV-0016). Organized into crews/gangs (aprw), phyles (zAw), and divisions (EV-0010, EV-0015). Workforce size estimates range widely from ~14,000 average to ~40,000 peak (EV-0014). The 'slave labor' idea originated with Herodotus and Hollywood, not archaeology (EV-0010, EV-0013).
